data.title: 爱西亚 · 暖融厨房里的下午茶烘焙时光
data.description: 午后阳光斜照的温馨厨房，爱西亚身着米白针织开衫与鹅黄长裙，端着用小隔热手套捧着的刚出炉香甜曲奇，眼眸闪烁期待。
data.action: 双手戴着可爱猫咪隔热手套端着烤盘，微微探身展示热气腾腾的刚烤好的点心
data.lighting: 窗台射入的暖融阳光，点心烤炉的橙色余温
data.camera: 中近景正面视线，营造面对面品尝甜点的亲昵感
data.promptProse: Asia Argento happily presents a hot baking sheet laden with golden freshly-baked cookies in a sunlit home kitchen. She wears a cozy cream-colored knit cardigan layered over a cheerful pastel yellow dress, with cute cat-themed oven mitts protecting her hands. Morning sun floods the wooden countertops, catching the soft steam rising from the cookies as she leans forward with an eager, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Asia beams with proud delight as she presents a hot tray of freshly baked cookies in the cozy morning kitchen.
